execution_verified_precision.definition: proven / (proven + disproven) restricted to findings that were executed; 1.0 by construction for published proven findings

self_caught_false_positive_rate.definition: disproven / attempted — findings the system itself refuted before publishing

human_dismissal_rate.definition: findings with a finding_outcomes row of 'dismissed' / findings that were ever published (published now, plus those a human dismissed off that set)

addressed_rate.definition: findings whose fingerprint disappeared on a later run of the same PR / published findings on PRs run more than once inside the window

caveats: Not an external benchmark. Every number is computed from this deployment's own database.
addressed_rate requires at least two runs on a PR; single-run PRs are excluded from n.

Outcome inference is a heuristic: a published fingerprint that disappears on a later run of the same PR is counted as addressed, and an explicit suppression is counted as dismissed. Neither is a confirmation by the author.
